The AI commit replaced Nashorn's --no-java evaluator with GraalJS HostAccess.ALL. The final fix disables host-class lookup, native access, threads, and process creation, directly reversing the new evaluator escape surface.

The AI commit exposed token-authenticated v1/v2 Users API resources by inheriting the base controller, while StoreUserRequest accepted any role and only checked authentication. The fix allowlists Admin/User and requires an existing Admin to assign Admin.

The AI member added /music/temp/ serving from a configurable temp directory and reused a separator-free startswith containment check. The fix appends the path separator; an older music path had the same flaw, so this is only the new temp-path contribution.

The AI-attributed revert removed the Azure certificate host allowlist, private-IP client, response-size cap, and generic error handling. The security fix restores those same controls, closing the SSRF and reachability oracle introduced by the revert.

The AI member retired the HTTPTrigger admission webhook while claiming CEL covered field rules, but RelativeURL and Prefix had no CEL validation. The final fix restores both CEL and Go validation for direct Kubernetes API creation.

The AI member added Untar symlink extraction using archive-controlled entry names and link targets without destination containment. The fix validates both entry paths and symlink targets; older regular-file ZipSlip paths remain a separate pre-existing root.

The AI member resolved reply recipients by mutable username/nickname through user_list and used that result for delivery. The fix gates name matching behind an explicit dangerous opt-in and defaults to the stable webhook numeric user_id.

The AI member began fetching Matrix thread-root bodies into new session context without checking the root sender. The fix records sender IDs and drops thread/reply context that does not satisfy the room sender allowlist.

The AI member removed richer plugin, hook, and remote-gateway protections and simplified the model-facing config mutation guard to an incomplete set-diff/denylist. The fix expands protected settings and catches per-agent array edits. Two advisory records describe the same candidate/fix guard component and are counted once.

The AI member added exec-event delivery through heartbeat-runner, creating a system-triggered context that inherited senderIsOwner semantics. The fix adds ForceSenderIsOwnerFalse for exec completions and makes command authorization honor it.

The AI member introduced the Synology Chat channel with inherited default webhook paths and replaceExisting route registration, allowing multi-account route ownership collapse. The fix requires explicit unique paths and removes replacement behavior.

The AI member extended oauth-proxy passthrough to generic OAuth callbacks that consume parseGenericState without binding cookie state to the incoming nonce. The fix stores and compares oauthState for every caller, including oauth-proxy. The advisory has no CVE.

The AI member introduced content-hash deduplication by truncating SHA-256 to 16 hex characters and using that value as observation identity. The fix replaces the weak truncated hash used by computeObservationContentHash.

The Claude-authored CLI commit created --format csv and a hand-written escapeCsv that only handled RFC 4180 quoting. The fix prefixes nonnumeric cells beginning with formula triggers before CSV escaping.

The AI member added OUROBOROS_CLI_PATH as an execution-affecting environment override. Because project-local .env files were loaded, a cloned repository could point it at attacker code. The fix blocks CLI-path and backend selectors from project-local .env loading.

The AI member added force_download for Anthropic DocumentUrl PDFs, causing server-side download_item fetches of message-supplied URLs. The fix adds redirect-aware SSRF protection and blocks private/cloud-metadata targets for forced downloads.

The AI member added a long-running frontend service to the platform Compose deployment without Docker log rotation. The fix adds bounded logging configuration to platform containers, including this new service; older services remain a pre-existing part of the advisory.

Two Claude-coauthored commits added BatchGetTraceInfos to the proto, server handler, and REST client. The new authenticated handler accepted arbitrary trace IDs without an authorization validator; the fix registers validate_can_batch_get_traces and the missing trace validators.

Copilot-coauthored TypeScript, C#, and Rust runtime commits each added ${file:...} resolution without an allowed-root boundary. The fix introduces root containment and traversal/symlink regression coverage across those runtimes.

The Copilot-coauthored TypeScript v2 runtime created an unrestricted Nunjucks Environment and rendered attacker-controlled templates with host objects. The fix blocks constructor/prototype traversal, function calls, and non-own input data. The advisory has no CVE.

The Copilot-coauthored TypeScript v2 loader called gray-matter with executable js/javascript frontmatter engines enabled. The fix rejects those engines before parsing; the advisory explicitly identifies the v2 rebuild as the reintroduction.

The AI member introduced Low/Medium/High shell risk classification and mapped Low to never require approval; low-risk prefix patterns such as env and sort allowed wrapper-based command injection. The fix tokenizes nested wrappers and adds env sh -c, time rm, and sort --compress-program regressions.

Atomic Claude-coauthored 21aea2d replaces garth with the native DI OAuth client and creates Client.dump(), which writes the refresh-token store through ordinary mkdir/write_text permissions. Atomic 77a3837 changes that exact sink to a 0700 directory and 0600 O_NOFOLLOW file. Merge f74174a is only the mainline carrier for the atomic fix and is not used as the fix edge.

Atomic Claude-coauthored 361e71d creates SmartOp and orders fee debit plus nonce increment before operation-specific checks that can fail. Atomic 2f5a3a2 completes the validate-before-mutate reversal for every SmartOp type. Earlier 45bcf70 fixes only Vote/CreateProposal and is retained as partial-fix history, not accepted as the complete reversal edge.

Atomic Claude-coauthored d1944bc releases v1.0.0 and introduces VMID variable support, resolving foo.gpp to foo.vmid and parsing untrusted XML. Atomic 9d0ba80 disables DTD processing and external resolution and adds entity and document-size bounds. The separate inc path-traversal CVE fixed in the same hotfix is excluded because its true feature origin 492e7fe has no explicit AI attribution.
